title: Installation
goal: Install KDL OS, run it and sign in for the first time.

title: Choose your flow
goal: Pick the right guide for what you want to build.

title: Flow 1: Admin only
goal: Run the internal business application with no public website.

title: Flow 2: Landing page only (with admin)
goal: Publish campaign pages without a full website.

title: Flow 3: Static website only (with admin)
goal: Ship a website as plain files hosted anywhere, with no live web app in front of visitors.

title: Flow 4: Web app and admin
goal: Run a live, editable website served from this installation.

title: Flow 5: Web app, landing pages and admin
goal: A full website plus separate campaign pages under one admin.

title: Flow 6: Static website and landing pages
goal: Host everything as plain files and keep campaign pages separate.

title: Flow 7: Web app and static website together
goal: Keep the live site and also publish a plain-file copy.

title: Flow 8: Full platform
goal: Website, landing pages, static export, membership and admin, all enabled.
